Warden v2 UI — grammar
1. Inbox first: the page opens with what needs a decision; everything else is secondary.
2. One status scale (Healthy / Degraded / Stale / Failing / Frozen) and one incident scale (Open / Awaiting approval / Executing / Resolved / Escalated / Closed) — used identically on every page.
3. Three actors, three labels: Warden, Gemini, Operator.
4. Incident = narrative (Summary → Evidence → Heartbeat) + decision rail (Detected → Diagnosed → Approval → Execute → Verify).
5. Structure over sentences: stat card, property list, table row. No explanatory copy on screen.
6. Light, neutral surfaces; color only for status, actor and the one accent.
